claim_or_verdict: Engineered + accidental/intended lab spread described as 'false in all respects'.
audit_issue: Category/scope compression, not clean factual error
evidence_at_date: Strong evidence against engineering; accidental leak was not equivalently disproved.
later_evidence: Conspiracy Watch distinguished accidental natural-virus lab escape from engineering by 16 Apr 2020; WHO 2025 still favors zoonotic spillover by weight of evidence but says a lab-related incident cannot be excluded with available information.
notes: The 9 Apr compound wording is a scope-compression case, not proof that CW denied every generic lab-leak scenario. Earliest confirmed actor-level distinction now 16 Apr 2020; not attached to the 9 Apr artifact.

claim_or_verdict: Survey treats 'fabricated accidentally in a laboratory' as laboratory-created category.
evidence_at_date: Accidental engineering and accidental release are not the same proposition.
later_evidence: Later public origin debate made this distinction central.

claim_or_verdict: Lab responsibility under investigation; corrections promised as facts emerge; no genome trace of known engineering.
evidence_at_date: Appropriately separates open lab-responsibility question from anti-engineering genomic evidence.

claim_or_verdict: Real hospital snapshot cannot be used alone to show vaccine inefficacy.
evidence_at_date: Hospital note must be contextualized by vaccine coverage/risk mix and updated data.

claim_or_verdict: Raw VigiAccess report counts do not establish that Covid vaccines are 10x more dangerous.
evidence_at_date: UMC: reports are suspected causal relationships, unproven; cannot compare safety profiles solely from reports.
later_evidence: OPECST 2022 likewise warns spontaneous reporting cannot directly yield incidence/risk without careful analysis.
notes: Specific F&F calculations/wording require original archived article; adversarial response is not independent adjudication.

notes: Later recommendation cannot be back-projected to erase the 3 Dec uncertainty.

notes: Positive repair case; exact original video should be archived for reach comparison.
